svg.title: ForePath One
svg.desc: ForePath One connects services and products into one thread: Agenstra, Decabill, Loadweaver, and the ForePath platform in one open source monorepo.
svg.text: Same engineers, same standards, less drift between strategy and production.

g.text: Run, govern, and ship with coding agents
Billing for agencies and digital products
Resilient clusters from a handful of servers
